---
title: "VELKSCALA 1.0."
subtitle: "Empirical Validation of Global Gridded Paleodemographics and Contemporary Vital Flows from 10000BC to the Present."
date: "28 October 2026"
authors_line: "Vis Tacitus and Aust Kätzchen"
emails:
  - vistacitus@confoederatio.org
  - austkaetzchen@confoederatio.org

hero_figure: "../../data/3.data_visualisation/images/cdt_proxy_vs_empirical.pdf"
hero_caption: "Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT) out-of-sample validation dashboard (1850--2019 AD) comparing country-level age-sex goodness-of-fit ($R^2$) and normalised median relative error for annual births and deaths."
hero_label: "fig:cdt-dashboard"

abstract: |
  Velkscala 1.0 is a global gridded demographic database reconstructing population counts, age-sex pyramids, and vital flows from 10000BC to 2025AD at 5-arcminute resolution, published by Confoederatio, Research Division. Our validation framework evaluates two foundational demographic regimes: the Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT, 1850--2019AD) against Human Mortality Database (HMD), United Nations World Population Prospects (UNWPP), and Niva et al. (Kummu) subnational vital records; and the Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT, 10000BC--1000AD) across five independent agricultural origins and 19 subnational geocodes against Bocquet-Appel paleodemographic priors. Across the CDT benchmark, isotonic Pool-Adjacent-Violators (PAVA) and Whittaker-Henderson graduation clamped to Stadester bounds elevate geometric mean age-sex goodness-of-fit ($R^2$) from 0,4625 (raw multinomial logit) to 0,6092 (+0,1466 improvement), reaching 0,8140--0,8736 across pre-1950 historical HMD cohorts. Across the NDT domain, raster cohort buffers confirm spatially endogenous age-structure differentiation across all 19 tracked geocodes and capture both the Bocquet-Appel immature juvenile proportion surge ($p(5\text{--}19)/p(5+)$) and the European Linearbandkeramik (LBK) boom-and-bust cycle.

bibliography: velkscala.bib
csl: crd-mla-numeric.csl
link-citations: true

output:

    template: ../../core/rticles/intellte/resources/template.tex
    latex_engine: xelatex
    keep_tex: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Bootstrap the Velkscala R Framework (paths, table/figure/prose templating, pagination)
source("../../core/framework/R/framework_init.R")

# Ingest CDT and NDT validation JSON artefacts via filepath_defines.json5
cdt_as_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(velkscala_defines$paths$cdt_age_sex_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)
cdt_bd_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(velkscala_defines$paths$cdt_births_deaths_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)
ndt_data    <- jsonlite::fromJSON(velkscala_defines$paths$ndt_results_json, simplifyVector = FALSE)
```

```{r layout-control, results='asis'}
# Emit float & pagination parameters to prevent page deadspace
emit_deadspace_control(list(compact_floats = TRUE, ragged_bottom = TRUE))
```

```{r intro-prose, results='asis'}
intro_template <- paste(
  "Continuous gridded reconstructions of historical human populations have traditionally",
  "relied on static regional growth multipliers or uniform age-structure templates [@hyde2017].",
  "In **Velkscala 1.0**, demographic cohorts and vital flows are generated endogenously",
  "at the pixel and geocode level across two coupled regimes: a premodern 34-covariate",
  "multinomial logit (MNL) ensemble governing the pre-industrial domain (10000 BC--1750 AD),",
  "and a rolling contemporary regime (1750--2025 AD) graduated via isotonic",
  "Pool-Adjacent-Violators (PAVA) and Whittaker-Henderson smoothing [@ayer1955; @whittaker1923].",
  "\n\n",
  "To verify out-of-sample fidelity before post-1950 United Nations census splicing,",
  "we subject the proxy estimators to two empirical stress tests. First, we evaluate",
  "the **Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT)** across £1£ benchmark epochs",
  "(1850--2019 AD, up to $N = £2£$ sovereign ISO3 jurisdictions), comparing raw MNL",
  "cohort probabilities and Stadester-clamped pyramids against empirical life tables",
  "from the Human Mortality Database (HMD) and UNWPP [@hmd2024; @unwpp2024], alongside",
  "vital birth and death stocks from Niva et al. [@niva2023]. Second, we audit the",
  "**Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT)** from 10000 BC to 1000 AD ($£3£$ epochs)",
  "across five independent agricultural hearths and $£4£$ national/subnational geocodes",
  "against archaeological juvenile mortality priors [@bocquet2002; @bocquet2008], alongside",
  "Holocene radiocarbon and land-use reconstructions [@shennan2013; @timpson2014; @hyde2017]."
)

render_markdown_prose(
  intro_template,
  list(
    euro_decimals = TRUE,
    include_tables = FALSE,
    vars = list(
      length(cdt_as_data$summary_by_epoch),
      189,
      length(ndt_data$regional_data[[1]]$epochs),
      length(ndt_data$tracked_geocodes)
    )
  )
)
```

Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT) Validation (1850--2019 AD) {#sec:cdt .unnumbered}
===========================================================================================

```{r cdt-prose, results='asis'}
raw_geomean_str   <- format_euro_number(cdt_as_data$overall_cdt$raw_mnl_geomean_r2, list(digits = 4))
clamp_geomean_str <- format_euro_number(cdt_as_data$overall_cdt$clamped_geomean_r2, list(digits = 4))
delta_geomean_str <- format_euro_number(cdt_as_data$overall_cdt$delta_geomean_r2, list(digits = 4, signed = TRUE))

cdt_narrative <- paste(
  "Across the contemporary validation horizon, graduating raw multinomial logit",
  "age-sex probabilities through isotonic PAVA and Whittaker-Henderson kernels [@ayer1955; @whittaker1923],",
  "clamped to Stadester total population bounds, substantially improves demographic",
  "fit. Across all evaluated country-epoch pairs, geometric mean $R^2$ rises from",
  "$£raw_r2£$ under raw MNL baseline probabilities to $£clamp_r2£$ post-clamping",
  "(an overall improvement of $\\Delta R^2 = £delta_r2£$; Figure \\ref{fig:cdt-dashboard}",
  "and Table \\ref{tab:cdt_age_sex}).",
  "\n\n",
  "Crucially, within the pre-1950 historical domain where proxy models operate",
  "as the primary estimator in Velkscala 1.0 [@hmd2024], clamped age-sex $R^2$ consistently",
  "exceeds $0.81$, reaching $0.8525$ in 1850 ($N = 8$ HMD countries), $0.8505$ in",
  "1900 ($N = 11$), $0.8736$ in 1920 ($N = 12$), and $0.8140$ in 1940 ($N = 16$).",
  "Post-1950 divergence reflects the expansion of the test sample from high-income",
  "European HMD registers to $N = 189$ global UNWPP jurisdictions [@hmd2024; @unwpp2024],",
  "which exhibit heterogeneous fertility transitions and subnational vital schedules [@niva2023];",
  "in the final Velkscala 1.0 composite, empirical UNWPP records directly replace",
  "proxy estimates from 1950 AD onwards (Table \\ref{tab:cdt_vital_flows})."
)

render_markdown_prose(
  cdt_narrative,
  list(
    euro_decimals = TRUE,
    vars = list(
      clamp_r2 = clamp_geomean_str,
      delta_r2 = delta_geomean_str,
      raw_r2 = raw_geomean_str
    )
  )
)
```

```{r tab-cdt-age-sex, results='asis'}
# Build Table 1 (CDT Age/Sex R^2 by Epoch) from JSON
as_epochs <- cdt_as_data$summary_by_epoch
as_rows <- lapply(as_epochs, function (ep) {
  data.frame(
    Year = as.character(ep$year),
    Source = as.character(ep$domain),
    N = as.character(ep$num_countries),
    Raw_M = format_euro_number(ep$raw_mnl$male_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Raw_F = format_euro_number(ep$raw_mnl$female_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Raw_Geo = format_euro_number(ep$raw_mnl$geomean_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Clamp_M = format_euro_number(ep$clamped$male_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Clamp_F = format_euro_number(ep$clamped$female_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Clamp_Geo = format_euro_number(ep$clamped$geomean_r2, list(digits = 4)),
    Delta_R2 = format_euro_number(ep$delta_geomean, list(digits = 4, signed = TRUE)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_cdt_as_table <- do.call(rbind, as_rows)

render_table_template(
  df_cdt_as_table,
  list(
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    caption = "Contemporary Demographic Transition (CDT) age and sex bracket goodness-of-fit ($R^2$) by benchmark epoch (1850--2019 AD), comparing raw multinomial logit (MNL) baseline probabilities against PAVA/Whittaker-graduated Stadester cohorts.",
    col_names = c(
      "Epoch", "Empirical Source", "Sample ($N$)",
      "Raw $R^2$ (M)", "Raw $R^2$ (F)", "Raw Geomean $R^2$",
      "Clamped $R^2$ (M)", "Clamped $R^2$ (F)", "Clamped Geomean $R^2$",
      "$\\Delta R^2$ Gain"
    ),
    font_size = "footnotesize",
    footnote = "Country R² is computed as the arithmetic mean of male and female cohort fits per ISO3 jurisdiction and aggregated across countries via geometric mean.",
    label = "tab:cdt_age_sex",
    placement = "!htbp",
    scale_to_fit = TRUE,
    span_columns = TRUE
  )
)
```

```{r tab-cdt-vital-flows, results='asis'}
    Emp_Deaths = format_semantic_number(ep$empirical_deaths, list(digits = 2)),
    Death_Err = format_euro_number(ep$death_error_pct, list(digits = 2, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%")),
    Net_Residual = format_semantic_number(ep$residual_natural, list(digits = 2)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE

render_table_template(
  df_cdt_bd_table,

    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),

      "Proxy Births", "Empirical Births", "Births Error",
      "Proxy Deaths", "Empirical Deaths", "Deaths Error",
      "Net Residual"

    font_size = "footnotesize",
```

Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT) Empirical Audit (10000 BC--1000 AD) {#sec:ndt .unnumbered}
=================================================================================================

```{r ndt-exec-prose, results='asis'}
ndt_prose_synthesis <- paste(
  c(
    paste(
      "This audit evaluates the **Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT)** across five major",
      "independent global agricultural origins and 19 subnational/national geocodes from",
      "$10000\\text{ BC}$ to $1000\\text{ AD}$ ($21$ historical epochs; Figure \\ref{fig:ndt_dashboard}",
      "and Table \\ref{tab:ndt_scorecard}). Under Bocquet-Appel's paleodemographic framework",
      "[@bocquet2002; @bocquet2008], the transition from mobile foraging to sedentary agriculture",
      "induced three canonical demographic signatures: (1) a transient surge in maternal fertility",
      "and annualised population growth ($r$\\%/yr) peaking approximately $\\Delta t \\approx 700\\text{--}800$",
      "years post-onset [@bocquet2002]; (2) a pronounced elevation in the immature juvenile proportion",
      "($p(5\\text{--}19)/p(5+)$), reflecting shortened interbirth intervals [@bocquet2008]; and (3) a",
      "subsequent post-boom deceleration or boom-bust contraction as agrarian density encountered",
      "ecological and epidemiological frontiers [@shennan2013; @timpson2014]."
    ),
    "### Key Audit Findings & Methodological Synthesis {.unnumbered}",
    paste(
      "- **Unique Age Structure Per Geocode (Refuting the 'Global Template' Fallacy)**:",
      "Direct audit of raster cohort buffers confirms that age-structure proportions are",
      "**spatially unique per geocode and per pixel**, driven by local covariates (cropland,",
      "shifting cultivation, irrigation, population density, and income) [@hyde2017], and graduated via",
      "isotonic PAVA/Whittaker algorithms [@ayer1955; @whittaker1923]. As shown in Table \\ref{tab:ndt_geocodes},",
      "at $0\\text{ AD}$ under-5 shares ($p(0\\text{--}4)$) range from $12.96\\%$ (South Korea)",
      "to $16.22\\%$ (Syria/Levant), while Bocquet-Appel juvenile ratios range from $30.15\\%$",
      "to $49.88\\%$. At $600\\text{ AD}$, Italy exhibits an elevated IJP ($41.66\\%$) amidst",
      "population contraction ($7.50\\text{M} \\rightarrow 3.06\\text{M}$), capturing demographic",
      "crisis dynamics associated with late antique mortality shocks."
    ),
    paste(
      "- **The European LBK Boom-and-Bust Dynamic**:",
      "In Europe, total population expands to $1.47\\text{M}$ at $6000\\text{ BC}$ before",
      "contracting to $1.12\\text{M}$ at $5000\\text{ BC}$ ($r = -0.027\\%$/yr; Table \\ref{tab:ndt_trajectories}).",
      "Rather than contradicting the NDT, this trajectory reproduces the empirically",
      "established **Early Neolithic Linearbandkeramik (LBK) boom-and-bust cycle**",
      "[@shennan2013; @timpson2014], wherein early farming communities expanded rapidly across",
      "European loess soils before experiencing soil depletion and pathogen-induced crashes",
      "prior to Middle Neolithic recovery ($+0.044\\%$/yr by $4000\\text{ BC}$)."
    ),
    paste(
      "- **Taphonomic Preservation and the Bocquet-Appel $p(5\\text{--}19)$ Signal**:",
      "Because infant skeletal remains ($p(0\\text{--}4)$) suffer differential taphonomic",
      "loss in archaeological cemeteries [@bocquet2002; @bocquet2008], the",
      "juvenile ratio $p(5\\text{--}19)/p(5+)$ serves as the primary osteological index of fertility.",
      "Across our gridded cohorts, this signal is robust across hearths, led by Southeast Asia",
      "($11.8\\times$ growth elevation; $+1.42\\text{ pp}$ IJP surge) and the American Southwest",
      "($1.6\\times$ elevation; $+2.79\\text{ pp}$ IJP surge peaking at $\\Delta t = +600$)."
    ),
    paste(
      "- **HYDE 3.2 Holocene Step Artefacts & Continental Smoothing**:",
      "Between $8000\\text{ BC}$ and $7000\\text{ BC}$, baseline",
      "population in HYDE exhibits a step increase across",
      "Eurasia ($+0.071\\%$/yr in Southwest Asia; $+0.080\\%$/yr in",
      "Europe) tied to Holocene climatic amelioration [@hyde2017]. Isolating this pre-onset step",
      "confirms that post-onset agricultural expansion remains distinctly elevated above",
      "homeostatic foraging baselines ($0.01\\text{--}0.03\\%$/yr) [@bocquet2008; @shennan2013], while continental raster",
      "integration naturally smooths micro-site cemetery peaks ($\\sim 0.8\\text{--}1.1\\%$/yr)",
      "to macro-regional millennial rates ($\\sim 0.07\\text{--}0.15\\%$/yr)."
    )
  ),
  collapse = "\n\n"
)

render_markdown_prose(
  ndt_prose_synthesis,
  list(
    euro_decimals = TRUE,
    include_tables = FALSE
  )
)
```

```{r tab-ndt-scorecard, results='asis'}
sc_list <- ndt_data$scorecard
sc_rows <- lapply(names(sc_list), function (reg_name) {
  sc <- sc_list[[reg_name]]
  elev_str <- if (!is.null(sc$elevation_ratio) && is.numeric(sc$elevation_ratio) && sc$elevation_ratio > 0) {
    paste0(format_euro_number(sc$elevation_ratio, list(digits = 1)), "x")
  } else {
    "Negative"
  }
  verdict_str <- if (isTRUE(sc$is_boom_artifact)) {
    "Indeterminate (Step Artefact)"
  } else if (!is.null(sc$elevation_ratio) && is.numeric(sc$elevation_ratio) && sc$elevation_ratio >= 3.0) {
    "Strong"
  } else if (!is.null(sc$elevation_ratio) && is.numeric(sc$elevation_ratio) && sc$elevation_ratio >= 1.2) {
    "Moderate"
  } else {
    "Weak (LBK Boom-Bust)"
  }

  post_dyn_str <- if (identical(reg_name, "Europe")) {
    "LBK Boom-Bust"
  } else if (identical(reg_name, "East Asia")) {
    "Lull -> Yangshao Boom"
  } else {
    "Steady Deceleration"
  }

  data.frame(
    Region = reg_name,
    Onset = as.character(sc$onset_label),
    Pre_r = format_euro_number(sc$pre_growth_rate_clean, list(digits = 3, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%")),
    Boom_r = paste0(
      format_euro_number(sc$boom_growth_rate, list(digits = 3, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%")),
      " (", as.character(sc$boom_interval_label), ")"
    ),
    Elevation = elev_str,
    Peak_r = paste0(
      format_euro_number(sc$peak_early_growth_rate, list(digits = 3, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%")),
      " (", as.character(sc$peak_early_interval), ")"
    ),
    Pre_IJP = format_euro_number(sc$ijp_pre_max, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
    Boom_IJP = paste0(
      format_euro_number(sc$ijp_boom_peak, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
      " (dt=", as.character(sc$ijp_peak_dt), ")"
    ),
    Surge_pp = paste0(
      format_euro_number(sc$ijp_delta_pp, list(digits = 2, signed = TRUE, suffix = " pp")),
      " (", format_euro_number(sc$ijp_relative_gain_pct, list(digits = 1, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%")), ")"
    ),
    Dynamic = post_dyn_str,
    Verdict = verdict_str,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_ndt_scorecard <- do.call(rbind, sc_rows)

render_table_template(
  df_ndt_scorecard,
  list(
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l", "l"),
    caption = "Cross-regional Neolithic Demographic Transition (NDT) hypothesis scorecard across five independent agricultural origins (10000 BC--1000 AD), evaluating pre-onset foraging growth baselines, post-onset boom elevation ratios, and Bocquet-Appel immature juvenile proportion ($p(5\\text{--}19)/p(5+)$) surges.",
    col_names = c(
      "Region", "Onset ($T_{\\text{onset}}$)", "Pre-NDT $r$",
      "Boom Window $r$", "Elevation", "Peak Early $r$",
      "Pre Max IJP", "Boom Peak IJP", "IJP Surge ($\\Delta$pp)",
      "Post-Boom Dynamic", "Audit Verdict"
    ),
    font_size = "scriptsize",
    label = "tab:ndt_scorecard",
    placement = "!htbp",
    scale_to_fit = TRUE,
    span_columns = TRUE
  )
)
```

```{r tab-ndt-trajectories-packed, results='asis'}
# Flush prior floats so Table 5 panels and References align without orphaned headings
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) cat("\\FloatBarrier\n")

# Build Table 5: Pack all 5 Regional 21-Epoch Paleodemographic Trajectories onto
# page-balanced composite floats
reg_names <- names(ndt_data$regional_data)
subtables_ndt <- lapply(seq_along(reg_names), function (idx) {
  r_name <- reg_names[idx]
  r_obj  <- ndt_data$regional_data[[r_name]]
  ep_rows <- lapply(r_obj$epochs, function (ep) {
    yr_num <- as.numeric(ep$year)
    yr_label <- if (yr_num < 0) paste0(abs(yr_num), " BC") else paste0(yr_num, " AD")
    dt_str <- if (as.numeric(ep$dt) >= 0) paste0("+", ep$dt) else as.character(ep$dt)
    dt_mid_str <- if (!is.null(ep$interval_dt_mid) && !is.na(ep$interval_dt_mid)) {
      if (as.numeric(ep$interval_dt_mid) >= 0) paste0("+", ep$interval_dt_mid) else as.character(ep$interval_dt_mid)
    } else {
      "---"
    }
    r_str <- if (!is.null(ep$growth_rate_pct) && !is.na(ep$growth_rate_pct)) {
      format_euro_number(ep$growth_rate_pct, list(digits = 3, signed = TRUE, suffix = "%"))
    } else {
      "---"
    }

    data.frame(
      Epoch = yr_label,
      Interval = as.character(ep$interval_label),
      Point_dt = dt_str,
      Mid_dt = dt_mid_str,
      Phase = as.character(ep$stage),
      Pop = format_semantic_number(ep$pop_stadester, list(digits = 2)),
      Growth_r = r_str,
      Cropland = format_semantic_number(ep$cropland_km2, list(digits = 1, unit = "km²")),
      Crop_PC = format_euro_number(ep$cropland_per_capita_m2, list(digits = 0, suffix = " m²")),
      Under5 = format_euro_number(ep$p_under5_pct, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
      IJP = format_euro_number(ep$p_5_19_bocquet_pct, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
      Imm_Tot = format_euro_number(ep$p_5_19_total_pct, list(digits = 2, suffix = "%")),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  list(
    df = do.call(rbind, ep_rows),
    title = paste0("Panel ", LETTERS[idx], ": ", r_name, " (Onset: ", r_obj$info$onset_label, ")")
  )
})

render_packed_subtables(
  subtables_ndt,
  list(
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    caption = "Regional paleodemographic trajectories across 21 historical epochs (10000 BC--1000 AD) for all five agricultural origins, packed across multi-panel pages.",
    col_names = c(
      "Epoch", "Interval", "Point $\\Delta t$", "Mid $\\Delta t_{\\text{mid}}$",
      "NDT Stage / Phase", "Population ($P$)", "Growth ($r$/yr)",
      "Cropland Area", "Cropland / Cap.", "$p(0\\text{--}4)$",
      "Bocquet IJP $p(5\\text{--}19)$", "Immature / Total"
    ),
    font_size = "scriptsize",
    footnote = "Population and cropland areas use semantic abbreviations (k = thousands, M = millions) and European decimals.",
    label = "tab:ndt_trajectories",
    max_rows_per_page = 46L,
    placement = "!t"
  )
)
```
